Method of Attack: Using DNS TXT records to deliver JavaScript commands that redirect users' browsers to scam or malicious sites
Obfuscated JavaScript in HTML email attachments that query Google's public DNS resolver for TXT records containing redirect URLs
Redirecting users to aggressive trading scam sites or potentially malware-installing pages
Attack Vector: Spam emails with HTML attachments named like invoic-B075.html containing obfuscated JavaScript
Indicators of Compromise: Domain used in DNS TXT record queries: fetch.vxpapub.ourmazdcompany.net
Use of Google's public DNS resolver URL: https://dns.google.com/resolve?name=fetch.vxpapub.ourmazdcompany.net&type=TXT
Associated IP addresses previously used by the Necurs botnet
